---
title: "Most draft-eligible college careers end without an NFL outcome at every position, and the undrafted route overtakes the draft after the first eligible season"
date: "2026-11-22"
description: "Followed season by season, at every position most draft-eligible college careers end with eligibility running out undrafted, the per-season chance of signing undrafted passes the chance of being drafted after the first eligible season, and counting only the drafted as an ending overstates the drafted share."
followups:
  - "Fit cause-specific hazard models of the four endings with position, conference tier and recruiting rating, as the competing-risks baseline for the draft forecast (F17)."
  - "Check whether the timing of each ending is stable across draft classes before a forecast relies on it."
  - "Compare cause-specific and subdistribution views of position: does a group change how often an ending happens, or how soon?"
  - "Split 'left the data' into transfers out of the data, injuries and early departures, which the data cannot yet tell apart."
  - "Add a school guard to the undrafted-signing match, since newly linked signings match the NFL roster's college less often than older links."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most draft-eligible college careers end without an NFL outcome at every position, and the undrafted route overtakes the draft after the first eligible season}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
per100 <- function(x) round(100 * x)

# One color per ending, shared by every figure; the two NFL routes carry the
# color, the endings without the NFL stay gray.
ending_lab <- ending_labels()
state_lab <- c(ending_lab, playing = "Still playing")
state_fill <- c(
  "Drafted" = "#1B9E77",
  "Signed undrafted" = "#7570B3",
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted" = "#6B7280",
  "Left the data" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Still playing" = "#F3F4F6"
)
claim_color <- "#B45309"
rec_lines <- c(Recruited = "solid", `No recruiting record` = "dashed")
context_color <- "#9CA3AF"

# ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) -----------------------------------
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who              , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Joe Burrow"      , "3915511"       ,
  "Jordan Travis"   , "4360799"       ,
  "Shane Buechele"  , "4039034"       ,
  "Kyle Allen"      , "559681"        ,
  "Jonathan Taylor" , "4242335"       ,
  "Montee Ball"     , "482389"        ,
  "Bumper Pool"     , "4360169"       ,
  "Paddy Fisher"    , "4035641"       ,
  "Colin Schooler"  , "4245685"       ,
  "Carlton Martial" , "4262107"       ,
  "Zane Zandier"    , "4240855"       ,
  "Ke'Shawn Vaughn" , "3917612"
)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
outcomes <- dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position and team per player-season (a handful of ids repeat).
roster_pos <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position,
          any_value(team) AS team
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team)) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, c(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")),
    recruited = if_else(hs_year_imputed, "No recruiting record", "Recruited")
  )
never <- never_eligible_entrants(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team))
comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded")

# ---- 2.2 The risk set ------------------------------------------------------
n_players <- nrow(endings)
n_known <- sum(endings$time > 0)
n_unknown <- n_players - n_known
n_never <- nrow(never)
never_qb <- sum(never$group == "Quarterback", na.rm = TRUE)
never_ol <- sum(never$group == "Offensive line", na.rm = TRUE)
n_missed <- sum(endings$missed_season)
risk_table <- endings |>
  mutate(ending = if_else(time == 0, "unknown", ending)) |>
  count(group, ending) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(
    count(mutate(never, group = factor(group, levels(endings$group))), group,
      name = "never_eligible"
    ),
    by = "group"
  ) |>
  mutate(never_eligible = coalesce(never_eligible, 0L))

# ---- 2.3 The named players -------------------------------------------------
last_team <- outcomes |>
  summarise(last = max(season), .by = "playerId") |>
  left_join(
    select(roster_pos, playerId, season, team),
    by = c("playerId", "last" = "season")
  )
cast <- subjects |>
  inner_join(endings, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  left_join(last_team, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  mutate(
    url = explorer_player_url(cfb_athlete_id, as.character(group)),
    Player = if_else(is.na(url), who, sprintf("[%s](%s)", who, url)),
    Ending = case_when(
      ending == "drafted" ~ sprintf("Drafted, round %d", round),
      .default = unname(ending_lab[ending])
    ),
    order = match(ending, names(ending_lab))
  ) |>
  arrange(order, desc(missed_season), hs_year_imputed)
vaughn <- cast[cast$who == "Ke'Shawn Vaughn", ]

# ---- 3.1 Cumulative shares by position ------------------------------------
horizon <- 3L
ci <- ending_incidence(endings)
ci_all <- ending_incidence(endings, by = NULL)
at_horizon <- ci |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  comparable() |>
  mutate(label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)))
nfl_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  summarise(nfl = sum(estimate), .by = "group") |>
  arrange(desc(nfl))
exhausted_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state == "exhausted_undrafted") |>
  arrange(estimate)
all_at <- function(s, t = horizon) {
  ci_all$estimate[ci_all$state == s & ci_all$time == t]
}
e1_holds <- any(nfl_share$nfl > 0.5)

# ---- 3.2 The drafted-only curve -------------------------------------------
naive <- naive_drafted(endings)
gap <- ci |>
  filter(state == "drafted") |>
  select(group, time, aj = estimate, lower, upper) |>
  inner_join(rename(naive, naive = estimate), by = c("group", "time")) |>
  comparable()
gap_h <- filter(gap, time == horizon) |> mutate(ratio = naive / aj)
qb_gap <- filter(gap_h, group == "Quarterback")
ol_gap <- filter(gap_h, group == "Offensive line")

# ---- 3.3 The per-season chance of each NFL route ---------------------------
# Seasons with fewer than 500 players at risk are too thin to read a rate.
min_risk <- 500
hz_all <- ending_hazards(endings, by = NULL) |>
  filter(ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), at_risk >= min_risk)
hz_group <- ending_hazards(endings) |>
  filter(ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), at_risk >= 100) |>
  comparable()
hz_at <- function(s, t) hz_all$hazard[hz_all$ending == s & hz_all$time == t]
hz_wide <- hz_all |>
  select(time, ending, hazard) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = hazard)
cross_season <- min(hz_wide$time[hz_wide$signed_udfa > hz_wide$drafted])
draft_peak <- hz_wide$time[which.max(hz_wide$drafted)]
last_hz <- max(hz_wide$time)
e3_holds <- all(diff(hz_wide$drafted) > 0)

# ---- 3.4 Recruited and unrecruited players ---------------------------------
treatments <- list(
  "Left the data is an ending (main view)" = ci,
  "Left the data is censored" = ending_incidence(endings, left_data = "censored"),
  "Recruited players only" = ending_incidence(filter(endings, !hs_year_imputed))
)
sens <- purrr::imap(treatments, \(x, nm) {
  x |>
    filter(state == "drafted", time == horizon) |>
    transmute(group, treatment = nm, estimate)
}) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  comparable()
ci_rec <- ending_incidence(endings, by = "recruited")
ci_rec_group <- endings |>
  comparable() |>
  mutate(cell = paste(group, recruited, sep = "|")) |>
  ending_incidence(by = "cell") |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cell, "|", names = c("group", "recruited"))
ever <- endings |>
  filter(ending != "censored") |>
  summarise(
    players = n(),
    drafted = mean(ending == "drafted"),
    mean_time_exhausted = mean(time[ending == "exhausted_undrafted"]),
    mean_time_drafted = mean(time[ending == "drafted"]),
    .by = "recruited"
  )
ever_of <- function(col, who) ever[[col]][ever$recruited == who]
share_recruited <- mean(!endings$hs_year_imputed)
e4_holds <- ever_of("drafted", "Recruited") > ever_of("drafted", "No recruiting record")
ld_shift <- sens |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(
    censored_shift = `Left the data is censored` -
      `Left the data is an ending (main view)`
  )
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-22. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are right-censored: a player whose next
outcome is not yet known counts as still playing up to his last known
season, never as a failure.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

The earlier posts counted how often a single eligible season ends in an NFL
outcome; this one follows each of `r fmt(n_players)` draft-eligible players
season by season until his college career ends, in one of four ways that
rule each other out, and asks how those endings differ by position.

+ *Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
  the NFL by their third eligible season.*
+ *Expecting each extra eligible season to raise a player's chance of being
  drafted that season.*
+ *Expecting recruited players to reach the draft more often than players
  without a recruiting record.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Each eligible player's college career ends once, in one of four ways

The table defines the clock, the four endings, and the two quantities every
figure reports; the curves describe position groups, never any one player's
chances.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term, ~Meaning,
  "Eligible season", "A college season with a stat line after which the next NFL draft could select the player (at least three years after high school). Season 1 is his first such season.",
  "Drafted", "Selected in the NFL draft after that season, or after later seasons without a stat line.",
  "Signed undrafted", "Not drafted, and first on an NFL roster the following season.",
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted", "His last college season, with no NFL outcome.",
  "Left the data", "Still on a college roster but with no further stat line, so his later path is not observed.",
  "Still playing", "Played on into another eligible season; once the next outcome is not yet known (a draft not yet complete), he counts as still playing up to his last known season.",
  "Missed season", "A season off the stat sheet (injury, a transfer sit-out) followed by a return; not an ending.",
  "Position group", "His roster position in his first eligible season, in the nine groups of the earlier position post.",
  "Cumulative share", "Of the group's eligible players, the share whose career has ended a given way by a given season. Each season's four shares plus the share still playing add to 100%.",
  "At risk", "Players still playing going into a season, the denominator for that season."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used throughout.")
```

### 2.2 `r fmt(n_known)` players have a known first eligible season, and `r fmt(n_never)` NFL entrants never become eligible by the clock

The table reconciles the players behind the curves: those whose first
eligible outcome is not yet known start no clock, and NFL entrants drafted
or signed before their first eligible season by the clock (early entrants,
or players whose estimated high-school year runs late) fall outside every
risk set, most of them offensive linemen.

```{r}
#| label: risk-set
risk_table |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(group),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Signed undrafted` = fmt(signed_udfa),
    `Eligibility ended` = fmt(exhausted_undrafted),
    `Left the data` = fmt(left_data),
    `Still playing` = fmt(censored),
    `Not yet known` = fmt(unknown),
    `NFL entrants never eligible` = fmt(never_eligible)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Players in the risk set by how their careers ended, and the NFL entrants the clock never makes eligible. Counts are players, not seasons.",
    align = "lrrrrrrr"
  )
```

### 2.3 Twelve players trace the four endings, and `r vaughn$who` shows a missed season that is not an ending

Each named player's path is computed from the data and links to his page in
the [Explorer](explorer.html); `r vaughn$who` left the stat sheet for a
season mid-career and came back, one of `r fmt(n_missed)` players with a
missed season.

```{r}
#| label: cast
cast |>
  transmute(
    Player,
    Position = as.character(group),
    `Last team` = team,
    `How it ended` = Ending,
    `In eligible season` = time,
    `High-school year` = if_else(hs_year_imputed, "Estimated", "From recruiting"),
    `Missed a season` = if_else(missed_season, "Yes", "No")
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "The named players, their endings, and the eligible season each ending fell in. Names link to the Explorer.")
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 By the third eligible season, no position sends more than `r per100(max(nfl_share$nfl))` in 100 eligible players to the NFL

*Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
the NFL by their third eligible season.* ❌

The first figure stacks each group's cumulative shares at season
`r horizon`: `r tolower(nfl_share$group[1])` leads with `r per100(nfl_share$nfl[1])` in
100 reaching the NFL by either route, while eligibility running out
undrafted claims at least `r per100(exhausted_share$estimate[1])` in 100 in
every group; the second follows every share season by season.

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 7
p31 <- at_horizon |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group))),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s players at risk going into season %d)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk), time
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(100 * estimate, group, fill = label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    # group = label keeps the stack in ending order; data_id would otherwise
    # set the stacking groups.
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state), group = label),
    width = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nfl_share |>
      mutate(group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group)))),
    aes(x = 101, y = group, label = sprintf("NFL %s", pct(nfl, 0))),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.6,
    color = claim_color
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 112),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Reaching the NFL is the minority ending in every group by season %d", horizon),
    subtitle = "Cumulative share of eligible players by how their college careers had ended; right: drafted plus signed undrafted",
    x = "Share of the group's eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Aalen-Johansen cumulative shares; hover a segment for its interval and the players at risk."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
girafe(ggobj = p31, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explore
#| fig-height: 10
p31b <- ci |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(state != "playing", n_risk >= 30) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, color = label, fill = label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state)), size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(state_fill[1:3], "Left the data" = "#9CA3AF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(state_fill[1:3], "Left the data" = "#9CA3AF")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    title = "Every ending, season by season, in every group",
    subtitle = "Cumulative share of eligible players by eligible season, with 95% intervals",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative share (%)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Seasons with fewer than 30 players at risk are omitted; hover a point for its interval."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p31b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```

### 3.2 Counting only the drafted as an ending overstates the quarterback drafted share by `r round(100 * (qb_gap$ratio - 1))`%

A player whose career ended another way can no longer be drafted, but a
survival curve with the draft as its only event treats him as if he might
still be (statisticians call this ignoring competing risks), so it reads
`r pct(qb_gap$naive)` of quarterbacks drafted by season `r horizon` against
the `r pct(qb_gap$aj)` the four-ending estimate gives; the second figure
shows the same gap for every group, widest for the offensive line.

```{r}
#| label: s32-explain
#| fig-height: 6
qb <- filter(gap, group == "Quarterback")
p32 <- ggplot(qb, aes(time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), fill = state_fill[["Drafted"]], alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = 100 * aj), color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = 100 * naive), color = claim_color, linewidth = 1.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(y = 100 * aj, tooltip = sprintf("Season %d: %s drafted, counting all four endings", time, pct(aj)), data_id = paste("aj", time)),
    color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(y = 100 * naive, tooltip = sprintf("Season %d: %s drafted, counting only the draft", time, pct(naive)), data_id = paste("km", time)),
    color = claim_color, size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = horizon + 0.08, xend = horizon + 0.08,
    y = 100 * qb_gap$aj, yend = 100 * qb_gap$naive,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = claim_color
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = horizon + 0.15, y = 100 * (qb_gap$aj + qb_gap$naive) / 2,
    label = sprintf("Overstated by\n%.1f points", 100 * (qb_gap$naive - qb_gap$aj)),
    hjust = 0, size = 4.6, color = claim_color
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = horizon + 0.6, y = 100 * max(qb$naive), label = "Draft as the only ending", hjust = 0, size = 4.4, color = claim_color) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.1, y = 100 * qb$aj[qb$time == 2] * 0.6, label = "All four endings", hjust = 0, size = 4.4, color = state_fill[["Drafted"]]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5, limits = c(0, max(qb$time) + 0.9)) +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted-only curve keeps counting quarterbacks whose careers already ended",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible quarterbacks drafted by each eligible season, two ways",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Drafted (%)",
    caption = "Solid: Aalen-Johansen with 95% interval. Dashed: one minus a Kaplan-Meier curve that censors every other ending."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p32, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explore
#| fig-height: 7
gap_order <- gap_h |> arrange(aj) |> pull(group) |> as.character()
p32b <- gap_h |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, gap_order)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = group)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 100 * aj, xend = 100 * naive, yend = group), color = context_color, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(x = 100 * aj, tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s drafted by season %d, counting all four endings (95%% CI %s to %s)", group, pct(aj), horizon, pct(lower), pct(upper)), data_id = paste(group, "aj")),
    color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(x = 100 * naive, tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s drafted by season %d, counting only the draft (%.1f times the four-ending share)", group, pct(naive), horizon, ratio), data_id = paste(group, "km")),
    color = claim_color, size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Every group's drafted share by season %d, both ways", horizon),
    subtitle = "Green: all four endings. Orange: the draft as the only ending.",
    x = "Drafted",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a point for the interval and the ratio between the two."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p32b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

### 3.3 The chance of being drafted peaks in eligible season `r draft_peak`, while the chance of signing undrafted climbs faster and passes it from season `r cross_season`

*Expecting each extra eligible season to raise a player's chance of being
drafted that season.* ❌

Of players still playing, `r pct(hz_at("drafted", 1))` are drafted after
their first eligible season and `r pct(hz_at("drafted", draft_peak))` after
season `r draft_peak`, then fewer, while the undrafted chance rises from
`r pct(hz_at("signed_udfa", 1))` to `r pct(hz_at("signed_udfa", last_hz))`
by season `r last_hz`; the faint lines are the individual groups.

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 6
hz_lab <- c(drafted = "Drafted", signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted")
p33 <- ggplot(mapping = aes(time, 100 * hazard, color = hz_lab[ending])) +
  geom_line(
    data = hz_group,
    aes(group = paste(group, ending)),
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = hz_group,
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s, season %d: %s %s (%s of %s at risk)", group, time, pct(hazard), tolower(hz_lab[ending]), fmt(events), fmt(at_risk)),
      data_id = paste(group, ending)
    ),
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_line(data = hz_all, linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = hz_all,
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("All positions, season %d: %s %s (%s of %s at risk)", time, pct(hazard), tolower(hz_lab[ending]), fmt(events), fmt(at_risk)),
      data_id = paste("all", ending, time)
    ),
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.05,
    y = 17,
    label = sprintf("From season %d, signing undrafted\nis the likelier NFL route", cross_season),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.4,
    color = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]]
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = state_fill[c("Drafted", "Signed undrafted")]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = hz_wide$time) +
  labs(
    title = "Waiting raises the undrafted chance far more than the drafted chance",
    subtitle = "Of players still playing going into each eligible season, the share drafted or signed undrafted that season",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Share that season (%)",
    color = NULL,
    caption = sprintf("Bold: all positions. Faint: each position group. Seasons with fewer than %s players at risk (all positions) or 100 (a group) are omitted.", fmt(min_risk))
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p33, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

### 3.4 Recruited players are drafted `r round(ever_of("drafted", "Recruited") / ever_of("drafted", "No recruiting record"), 1)` times as often as players without a recruiting record, a gap in who they are more than in the clock

*Expecting recruited players to reach the draft more often than players
without a recruiting record.* ✅

The table gives each group's drafted share by season `r horizon` under the
two alternative treatments: counting leaving the data as censoring moves it
by at most `r round(100 * max(abs(ld_shift$censored_shift)), 1)` points,
while keeping only the `r pct(share_recruited, 0)` of players with a
recruiting record raises it sharply, because recruited players end their
careers drafted `r pct(ever_of("drafted", "Recruited"))` of the time against
`r pct(ever_of("drafted", "No recruiting record"))` for the rest; the
figures show that the estimated high-school year shifts mainly the timing
of eligibility running out, in eligible season
`r round(ever_of("mean_time_exhausted", "No recruiting record"), 1)` on
average without a recruiting record against
`r round(ever_of("mean_time_exhausted", "Recruited"), 1)` with one.

```{r}
#| label: s34-table
sens |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = estimate) |>
  arrange(desc(`Left the data is an ending (main view)`)) |>
  mutate(across(-group, pct)) |>
  rename(`Position group` = group) |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf("Share of each group's eligible players drafted by eligible season %d under three treatments.", horizon),
    align = "lrrr"
  )
```

    caption = "Each panel has its own scale. Seasons with fewer than 30 players at risk are omitted."
  ) +

girafe(ggobj = p34, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)

## 4. Summary

Followed to their ending, most eligible careers at every position run out
undrafted, the undrafted route becomes the likelier way into the NFL after
the first eligible season, and the drafted share depends far more on who
is counted than on how the endings are treated.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation, ~Verdict, ~Evidence,
  sprintf("At least one group sends most eligible players to the NFL by season %d", horizon), if (e1_holds) "✅" else "❌", sprintf("The highest, %s, is %s", nfl_share$group[1], pct(nfl_share$nfl[1])),
  "Each extra eligible season raises the chance of being drafted", if (e3_holds) "✅" else "❌", sprintf("It peaks in season %d at %s, then falls", draft_peak, pct(hz_at("drafted", draft_peak))),
  "Recruited players reach the draft more often", if (e4_holds) "✅" else "❌", sprintf("%s against %s of players with a known ending", pct(ever_of("drafted", "Recruited")), pct(ever_of("drafted", "No recruiting record")))
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The NFL routes compete with each other and with the end of eligibility.

- Each season a player stays, the undrafted chance grows faster than the
  drafted chance, so a forecast that pools the two routes, or ignores the
  endings that compete with them, mixes processes that move in different
  directions over a career.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The drafted-only curve is the wrong yardstick.

- Treating every other ending as censoring keeps counting careers that
  already ended, so it overstates the drafted share in every group, most
  where other endings are most common.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Who is counted matters more than how.

- Players without a recruiting record make up most of the risk set and are
  drafted far less often; for them the data says how a career ended more
  reliably than when, because their high-school year is estimated.
:::

Several caveats bound these figures. The population is players with a stat
line, so the offensive line rate describes the few linemen who left one,
and its curves thin out after season 2. "Left the data" mixes transfers out
of the data, injuries and early departures that the data cannot separate.
Position is fixed at the first eligible season, so a player who changed
position later is counted at his first one. The most recent classes are
right-censored, and their later seasons carry fewer players at risk.
